LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.0.label: ate guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.0.descri: I swallowed some guanyin clay. There is something in my stomach, but I still want a proper meal.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.1.label: ate more guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.1.descri: I swallowed another lump of clay, and my stomach feels uncomfortably full. This is not what I want to eat.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.2.label: enough guanyin clay
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_ClaySatiety.stages.2.descri: I have eaten several lumps of clay. I can still taste the dirt. Please, no more of this.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.0.label: still hungry
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.0.descr: I am hungry. My stomach aches for food.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.1.label: plea for food went unanswered
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineHunger.stages.1.descr: I am hungry. I asked for food, but never got a bite.
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineFed.stages.0.label: finally full
LanguageData.RHAH_Thought_FamineFed.stages.0.descript: That meal filled me up. At last, I can stop thinking about my empty stomach.
